title: Paragraph & Line Spacing (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Paragraph & Line Spacing applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Paragraph & Line Spacing (BtnParagraphDialog) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Line-spacing presets and paragraph-spacing removal pinned on a real host
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host the deterministic right-click presets run on a two-paragraph text shape whose paragraph spacing was pre-set to 10pt before and after: the 1.5 preset lands on ParagraphFormat.SpaceWithin=1.5, the single preset on 1.0, and RemoveParagraphSpacing zeroes SpaceBefore and SpaceAfter. The run reports execution and writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
